titles.description: “Stranded” follows Jenny as she struggles to rebuild her life after discovering her husband David’s infidelity. Caught between her father’s call to forgive and her own deep emotional pain, she is forced to make a life-altering decision about her marriage and her future.

titles.description: Kolade is a young man determined to pursue his passion despite a strained and complicated relationship with his father. But when he falls in with the wrong crowd, ambition quickly pulls him into a dangerous entanglement.

titles.description: A vibrant Deacon sent out his wife for another strange woman who unknown to him was sent to destroy his ministry. In no time, he became obstinate and unrepentant and suffered satanic afflictions

This is the story of the Olakunle Family.
On the surface, they appear to be the perfect family, but behind the scenes, everything is falling apart.

titles.name: Fiwajomi
